propositions: The close precheck scans all reachable commit messages and calls resolve_ticket_id for every extracted reference, causing unrelated ambiguous short-prefix errors to print to stderr.
resolve_ticket_id prints ambiguity diagnostics unconditionally even when called from history-scanning contexts that only need a boolean return value.
The precheck gate decision and return semantics are unaffected by these diagnostic errors; they are pure noise.
A quiet=False keyword parameter added to resolve_ticket_id gates three stderr ambiguity prints; _referencing_commit_exists passes quiet=True only during history scans.
User-facing commands that receive explicit ambiguous target IDs still receive full diagnostics because they resolve without quiet.
The fix preserves correct gate behavior while eliminating spurious diagnostics from unrelated historical commit references.
